cases.steps: Install the x86_64 development APK on the Android emulator, start the bundled app through Metro, and inspect logcat.
cases.expected: IT SUPPORT opens to sign-in with Eduvos branding; no application crash.

cases.steps: Submit the sign-in form with both fields empty.
cases.expected: A clear required-fields message appears; protected screens remain inaccessible.

cases.steps: Submit outsider and lookalike domains; then enter student and staff domain addresses.
cases.expected: Outsiders and lookalikes are rejected; vossie.net and eduvos.com pass domain validation.

cases.steps: Open registration and submit all fields empty.
cases.expected: Name, institutional email and password requirements appear next to their inputs.

cases.steps: Submit a valid institutional email and a password shorter than 12 characters.
cases.expected: Registration is prevented with a minimum-length message.

cases.steps: Register a synthetic student using the real native Auth SDK connected to the Auth emulator.
cases.expected: Account is created; verification screen prevents ticket access before verification.

cases.steps: Resend verification, apply the local emulator action code, then check verification in the app.
cases.expected: Local verification action is generated; checking it opens onboarding after confirmation.

cases.steps: Sign out, sign in with the verified local student account, then restart the app.
cases.expected: Sign-in succeeds and the session persists after restart.

cases.steps: Attempt sign-in with an existing student email and an incorrect app password.
cases.expected: An error appears and sign-in remains available for retry.

cases.steps: Sign out from Profile, confirm the dialog, then press Android Back and relaunch.
cases.expected: Sign-in is shown; previous protected screens cannot be reopened.

cases.steps: Reject an invalid reset address; request a reset for a local verified account and apply the local action code.
cases.expected: Invalid email is rejected; a local reset action is generated; the new app password can sign in.

cases.steps: Sign in with a verified local eduvos.com account without a support claim.
cases.expected: Staff can maintain their own profile and tickets; the shared queue stays unavailable.

cases.steps: Use an approved Entra registration and a real vossie.net Microsoft account on a physical phone.
cases.expected: Organizational sign-in, consent/MFA and callback complete; the correct institutional identity opens the app.

cases.steps: Repeat organizational sign-in with a real eduvos.com staff account; cancel once and retry.
cases.expected: Cancellation is recoverable; successful sign-in does not grant support without a custom claim.

cases.steps: Submit missing campus/number and an invalid institution number.
cases.expected: Missing or invalid details are rejected with clear messages.

cases.steps: Complete student name, institution number and campus; view Profile and inspect the local Firestore emulator record.
cases.expected: Details appear correctly and persist locally and in the test backend.

cases.steps: Edit name and campus, save, restart and view Profile again.
cases.expected: Updated details remain after restart and synchronize to the test backend.

cases.steps: Cancel deletion once, then delete profile details and complete onboarding again.
cases.expected: Cancel preserves details; confirmed deletion clears profile details while retaining identity and ticket history.

cases.steps: Submit an empty new-ticket form, then a title shorter than five characters.
cases.expected: Required category/title/description feedback appears; invalid tickets are not stored.

cases.steps: Choose category and priority, enter title/description/location and log the ticket.
cases.expected: A unique reference and matching details appear; the ticket reaches the test backend.

cases.steps: Open Edit, change title, description and location, save and reopen.
cases.expected: Changed values persist and appear in the test backend.

cases.steps: Post a reply, reopen the ticket and inspect its comment collection.
cases.expected: Reply appears once with author information and is persisted in the test backend.

cases.steps: Close an owned ticket, then reopen it.
cases.expected: Status changes are visible and persisted, with appropriate available actions.

cases.steps: Create a second ticket and use available status filters.
cases.expected: Matching tickets are shown and the empty result state is clear.

cases.steps: Cancel deletion once; then confirm deletion of one ticket.
cases.expected: Cancel preserves it; confirmed deletion removes it from the requester list and stores a tombstone.

cases.steps: Sign in with a locally granted support claim, open Queue and assign an existing ticket.
cases.expected: The shared queue opens only for support; assignment is persisted.

cases.steps: Resolve a ticket as support and sign back into its owner account.
cases.expected: The owner sees the resolved status and support update.

cases.steps: Switch between student and ordinary staff accounts with separate tickets.
cases.expected: Neither account sees the other account cache or requester tickets.

cases.steps: Attempt a cross-owner Firestore read with the ordinary staff emulator ID token.
cases.expected: The actual Firestore emulator rules deny access.

cases.steps: After successful sync, disable Android Wi-Fi/data and open saved ticket details.
cases.expected: Cached tickets and comments remain readable with offline feedback.

cases.steps: Create a ticket and reply while offline; force-stop and reopen the app.
cases.expected: Unsent work survives restart and pending state remains visible.

cases.steps: Restore Android connectivity and trigger sync; inspect the test backend twice.
cases.expected: Queued changes upload once without duplicate replies; pending count clears.

cases.steps: Visit each implemented screen and use Android Back through edit/detail/auth flows.
cases.expected: Navigation is understandable and Back returns safely without exposing protected routes.

cases.steps: Focus long-form fields, scroll to actions and submit on the emulator screen.
cases.expected: Inputs remain editable and actions can be reached while using the keyboard.

cases.steps: Switch Android to dark mode and inspect sign-in, list and detail screens.
cases.expected: Blue branding, text, controls and feedback remain readable.

cases.steps: Set Android font scale to 1.3, inspect key forms and return to normal.
cases.expected: Content can be read and actions reached without a crash or inaccessible form.

cases.steps: Inspect UI Automator labels and activate major form/navigation controls.
cases.expected: Inputs and main actions have meaningful labels and respond to user actions; no TalkBack user study is implied.

cases.steps: Attempt sign-in while the device has no network, then restore connectivity and retry.
cases.expected: Failure is understandable and recoverable; the app remains usable.

cases.steps: Restart the app and repeat major tab/detail transitions; inspect package-specific crash/ANR evidence.
cases.expected: The executed sequence completes without an unresolved application crash or ANR.

cases.steps: Verify the ARM64 APK signature, checksum, name, ABI, SDK levels and transfer ZIP integrity.
cases.expected: APK is signed, self-contained and packaged with accurate Android installation/WhatsApp instructions.
